name: @aethelred/wallet-swap-venue-uniswap-v3
description: Uniswap v3 implementation of the @aethelred/wallet-swap-solver SwapVenue interface. QuoterV2 for quoting, SwapRouter02 for settlement (single-hop exactInputSingle), Pool Swap event for fill-amount decode. Zero runtime deps — hand-rolled ABI encoders/decoders matching the wallet stack's bundle-discipline. Validates the venue abstraction with a production DEX.
